scientific_question: Within one GFP library and one observed-R1 feature definition, does MFE transport across host or 5-prime-UTR-intron contexts after whole-sequence-cluster separation?
mechanistic_hypothesis: If predicted initiation/local structure has a context-transportable association with Flow-seq, adding the three frozen observed-R1 MFE features to identical sequence/codon covariates improves source-trained prediction on held-out target-context clusters. Host transport and intron transport are evaluated separately; failure of any family endpoint rejects the corresponding broad transport claim and does not prove a universal null mechanism.

hela_no_intron.experiment_title: Illumina MiSeq sequencing: Flow-Seq of GFP library without intron in HeLa cells

hela_with_intron.experiment_title: Illumina MiSeq sequencing: Flow-Seq of GFP library with intron in HeLa cells

hek293_no_intron.experiment_title: Illumina MiSeq sequencing: Flow-Seq of GFP library without intron in HEK293 cells

download.transport: parallel verified HTTP byte ranges; complete-file ENA size and MD5 gate before atomic rename; SHA256 recorded

fixed_reference_counting.references: All 152 RK28 observed-R1 sequences in the frozen reference CSV order; no de novo centroids and no outcome-informed selection.
fixed_reference_counting.assignment: Unique minimum-Hamming reference within 8 nt using the frozen nine-segment exact-seed index; ties, >8 nt, non-300-nt reads are unassigned.

outcome_and_qc.replicate_rule: Every one of the eight experiments must have all eight bins and at least 1,000 assigned reads for a variant; no replicate may be dropped after inspecting scores.
outcome_and_qc.context_score: Unweighted arithmetic mean of replicate-level scores within each context.
outcome_and_qc.common_cohort: Intersection of variants passing the read-support rule in all eight experiments across all three contexts.
outcome_and_qc.coverage_failure: If either minimum fails, stop before model fitting as MATCHED_CONTEXT_COVERAGE_INFEASIBLE_ZERO_FITS; no alternate threshold or subset search is allowed.
outcome_and_qc.interpretation: Weighted fluorescence-bin score from injected/library Flow-seq measurements; not translation velocity, mRNA decay, direct RFU, or a universal expression scale.

features.depth_excluded_reason: Read depth is a condition-specific technical measurement and is not used as a transported biological predictor; it remains in QC.
features.structure_engine: ViennaRNA RNA.fold_compound MFE; DNA converted to RNA; 37 C; dangles=0; full observed 300-nt fragment and every contiguous 48-nt window; identical to RK28.

outer_evaluation.fold_assignment: Reuse RK28 whole-cluster assignment algorithm and seeds on the common-cohort clusters. For transport, source outcomes from test clusters are excluded from training and target held-out clusters are never used for fitting or scaling.
outer_evaluation.leakage_rule: No sequence cluster may occur in both source training and target testing. Hyperparameters and feature sets are frozen; no target-informed tuning.

models.ridge: Training-fold feature and outcome mean/population-standard-deviation scaling, then Ridge(alpha=1.0, solver=cholesky).
models.histgb: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=10, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=seed+fold).

primary_transport.effect_direction: Spearman structure-minus-simple; MSE simple-minus-structure; positive favors structure.
primary_transport.multiplicity: One Holm family across all 16 ordered-pair primary endpoints.
primary_transport.seed_rule: At least 8 of 10 seed-level effects must be positive for each endpoint.
primary_transport.pair_pass_rule: All four endpoints for a direction have effect>0, 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound>0, family-Holm p<0.05 and >=8/10 positive seeds.
primary_transport.family_pass_rule: All four directions pass. Otherwise CONTEXT_TRANSPORTABLE_MFE_INCREMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED; report each direction separately and do not claim a universal negative mechanism.

secondary_within_context.inference: Descriptive/secondary four structure-increment endpoints per context with 10,000 cluster bootstraps/permutations and Holm across the 12 secondary tests; not allowed to rescue a failed primary transport family.
